args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and health checks were failing. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` in all three regions.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): Documented that checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that the on-call engineer was paged for root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
